main_body: A small brown gnarled stump/root cluster (about 15x15 px) with a few green moss patches and a near-black outline, set against a transparent background with grey stone-like tiles around it. It is drawn as a flat brown mass.
top_band: none: the column at x=8 reads an outline row, then brown L~60 for 3 rows, an outline row and a flat brown body L~54 for 9 rows with no lighter top surface
evidence: The scan shows no lighter top band separated from the body by a step of 25 L or more. The brown body stays at L 54-74 and is broken only by near-black outline rows, and the green moss at x=11 is a small patch. It reads as a flat front view of roots or a stump with no horizontal surface visible from above, so it does not satisfy the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 7 colours per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. 96% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is a near-black sticker line, while the references have tinted outlines (0% neutral). It has only about two brown tones plus a little green, which is shallow shading with no leaf clumps or bark grain. It is far thinner than the Beodeul trees.
